_comment: Add-ons Astra can install for its features (astra addons, and setup's Add-ons step). packages are Arch package names, checked with pacman -Si in CI (.github/workflows/package.yml). bins say an add-on is installed. Model names are the defaults Astra pulls (ollama.com/library, 2026-11-15); whisper.cpp is built from its release tag (github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp, v1.9.5; flags checked in examples/server/server.cpp) with the model from huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp. signal-cli is not in Arch's repositories, so it is upstream's native build (github.com/AsamK/signal-cli releases, no Java needed, x86_64), checked by its SHA-256.

video.label: Videos
video.blurb: Play your videos and YouTube links in mpv.

music.label: Music controls
music.blurb: Pause, play and skip Spotify and other players.

local.label: Private local AI
local.blurb: Ollama on this computer, for system checks, the morning brief and finding files by meaning. About 3 GB.

voice.label: Speak to Astra
voice.blurb: whisper.cpp turns your voice into text on this computer. Builds in a few minutes, about 150 MB.

signal.label: Signal
signal.blurb: Read your Signal messages and reply from Astra, linked to your phone like Signal Desktop. About 120 MB.
